Legato 0.9.9 is mostly about Notes: meetings you can ask questions of, speakers that match the people in the room, and folders. Everything still runs on your PC; only your own AI provider, if you set one, is called over the internet.

## Notes

- Folders for notes, next to tags. Move a note from its menu; deleting a folder keeps its notes.
- Next steps from every note in one list, and Ask across all your notes.
- Summaries shaped to the kind of meeting (team, one-on-one, sales and more), with topics, people and timed details.
- Speakers: no more invented voices. Short slivers fold into real people, the people known to be in a call cap the count, and every line on the other side gets a speaker.
- Summaries no longer treat "Them" as a person's name.
- Meet calls add the names of the people in them to the note.
- Ask before keeping a note started by mistake, and offer to keep recording before the length limit.
- What did I miss, from the side panel.
- Google Docs copies and calendars from iCal addresses, with no sign-in.

## The bar and the island

- The island's words are see-through (Settings › Legato bar › Background) and clicks go through them; its controls stay solid.
- The resting island steps aside for fullscreen remote desktops (RustDesk, VNC) as it does for videos and games. A dictation or a call still brings it out.

## Dictation

- Say "press enter" to send, and each paragraph goes as its own message.
- Microphones in order: when the first isn't plugged in, the next one records.
- History keeps 48 hours, capped by the entry limit.
- Talk to Inyon's companion agent from the bar.

## Phone

- Transforms on the phone, with the PC's AI keys kept sealed; choose the phone's speech model.
- Many fixes to the bubble, Chrome fields and clipboard sync on Android.

## Fixes

- The .msi installs under Program Files.
- A dictation cancelled while the model loads no longer starts a stream.
- Folders and Tags fit beside the notes filter.
